agentUtterance.text: Promoting inclusion and accessibility within our Bell community is core to our customer experience. Accessibility relates to identifying, preventing, and removing barriers for persons with disabilities. Applicable customers can certainly enrol in our Accessibility program. I'll send a text to the device you're calling from, with a link to complete the form. Is that alright?

inputActionParameters.sms_content: Bell Msg: Thanks for calling to enrol in Bell's Accessibility Services! Click https://www.bell.ca/Styles/common/all_languages/all_regions/pdf/Bell_Accessibility_Services_Form.pdf to view the application form. (bell.ca/about-us)
